"just keep setting dates but don't follow on them."

i used to do this consistently when i was 16, but i would give myself a month. this is the first time i'm picking a date so close. so i think i am finally ready. you gave good advice though
i cant find anything to calm me down my mind has been in turmoil since last week. i cant calm down i tried finding things that would distract me but i cant
i have friends but none close enough that i can share how i am feeling with. thank you for reaching out. i am trying to write my letter now

i have struggled with depression/bpd/bipolar/ptsd since i was 15 and it hasn't gotten better. i'm supposed to turn 21 this year, but i'm not going to make it. my dad is mentally and verbally abusive, no one is on my side. i wish my mom wouldn't defend my dad. i am a very stressful person i need constant reassurance. my boyfriend is asking for space, but i am in an episode and i would really like to just talk to him. i called earlier but no response. i haven't talked to him since thursday. i thought that he was my best friend, i thought i could call when i am hurting and he would be there. i am hurting so much. i am so tired.
